title: Core Trio #31
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, three women in a single row.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 3 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Jamaican woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, cool and composed, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes. Long square nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting — a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense curling floral scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold plain stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a bold cheeky grin, sultry, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Italian Deruta majolica — a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following every deep crease, dense repeating floral border filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Center woman's footwear: extreme cobalt-and-ochre extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Hawaiian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, demure and soft, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework — a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease, dense geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: leaning one arm on a window frame.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold-and-red platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 3, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
